text.en:
Budget. - The secretary of the Department of
Budget is hereby directed to release the amount of Five Mittio., pesos
(P5,000,000.00) from the President's contingent Fund (pcF), to initiaily
cover the operational expenses of the Committee and its Secretariat.
Thereafter, additional funds shall be released by the DBM subject to the
submission of a work and Financial plan as may be drawn up for the
purpose by the Committee.
